scope: isolated read-only audit; canonical trajectory outputs are untouched

urdf.source: externally supplied AGILEX Piper URDF; SHA-256 retained

official_kinematic_reference.name: J6/link6 frame origin
official_kinematic_reference.status: unambiguous URDF/FK frame; not inferred from a visual surface

z53_inner_annular_shoulder.assessment: annular shoulder around the J6 axis, but the z group has overlapping +Z/-Z faces and many disconnected side features; it is recessed 3 mm behind the broader z=56 front face

z56_connected_annular_front_face.assessment: best topology-backed visible flange/front-plate candidate: one connected +Z planar component surrounds the J6 axis, has a central bore and bolt holes, and is the distal face of the layered 53-56 mm flange-like stack
z56_connected_annular_front_face.confidence: medium; mesh topology supports the face, but URDF has no named mounting datum

z67_max_cap_rejected.assessment: rejected as a flange face: four disconnected lateral pads at |x|=62-72 mm; their area-weighted symmetry center lies in empty space on the J6 axis

distal_fingertip_end_face_midpoint.assessment: area-weighted midpoint of the two terminal finger end faces whose normals point along -link6 Z; a distal-tip tracking point, not the extended inner gripping/contact surface and not a flange datum

finger_joint_root_legacy.assessment: URDF joint7/joint8 root plane; not the fingertip and not the mounting flange

finger_geometry_semantics.interpretation: The terminal end faces point along -link6 Z and lie farthest from the z=135.03 mm finger-joint roots. The broad inner gripping surfaces point along +/-link6 X and do not define one unique axial TCP point. The mesh maximum-Z caps are near the roots, not the distal fingertip.

uniqueness_conclusion: The official flange/J6 kinematic origin is uniquely z=0. For a user-visible distal mounting/front plate, z=56 mm is the strongest mesh-topology candidate. It must remain a separately named visual_flange_face_candidate because the URDF does not label a CAD mating datum and a neighboring annular shoulder exists at z=53 mm. The earlier z=67 mm max-cap interpretation is invalid.

recommended_schema.j6_origin_xy: official logged/FK link6 origin at local [0,0,0]
recommended_schema.visual_flange_face_candidate_xy: separate local [0,0,0.056] projection; medium-confidence physical face center
recommended_schema.distal_tip_xy: link7/link8 terminal end-face midpoint at local [0,0,0.067979425]
recommended_schema.tcp_xy: may alias distal_tip_xy only when that tool-center policy is explicitly desired

ep1952_projection.policy: retain episode 216 K/B; replace only isolated camera extrinsic with E217
